errors.unknown_verb: That is not something Garrison can ask a server to do.

errors.needs_pro: That is part of Garrison Pro. This forum is running the free edition, which covers one host and one server.
errors.host_limit: The free edition of Garrison covers {max} host. Garrison Pro removes the limit.
errors.upload_failed: That file did not arrive. Try again.
errors.not_an_image: That is not an image Garrison can use. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.

errors.no_artwork: Garrison does not know where to find artwork for this game. Upload an image instead.

forum.action_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
forum.console_empty: Nothing here yet. Output appears as the server produces it.
forum.console_placeholder: Type a command for the server
forum.confirm_stop: Stop {name}? Anybody playing will be disconnected.

health.attention_detail: Garrison restarted this server and it did not come back. Automatic restarts have stopped.
health.unchecked: Not checked — no readiness probes are set up for this game.

forum.server_not_here: That server is not here. It may have been removed, or its host may not be paired any more.

config.title: Server settings
config.none: This server has no settings files set up. They are declared in the agent's config file on the game host.
config.file_empty: There is nothing in this file.
config.read_only: These settings can be read but not changed.
config.locked: This one cannot be changed from here.

playing.title: {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} in the game

link.title: Your in-game account
link.explain: Link your forum account to your character, so your playtime counts here. Join the server, type your in-game name below, and Garrison will send you a code in the game. Your character will be shown on your profile.
link.check_the_game: Garrison has sent a code to that player in the game. Read it there and type it below.
link.linked: You are linked to {player} on this server.

backups.title: Backups
backups.none: No backups yet. One will appear here after the next backup runs.
backups.confirm_restore: This replaces what is on the server right now with this backup. A copy of the current state is taken first, so this can be undone.
backups.confirm_restore_stops: This server is running, so it will be stopped first. It is left stopped afterwards, so you can check the restore before letting players back in.
backups.confirm_delete: This deletes the backup from the host. It cannot be undone.

offsite.none: Backups are kept on the game host only. Copies to off-site storage are set up in the agent's config file.
offsite.unknown: Also copied to {bucket}. Nothing has been copied since this agent last started.

outcome.done_restore: Restored. A copy of the previous state was saved first.
outcome.failed_stop: The server would not stop, so nothing was restored.
outcome.waiting_create: Still working. The backup is running on the host.
outcome.waiting_restore: Still working. The restore is running on the host.

admin.title: Garrison
admin.webhook_help: Posted to when a server stops accepting players, and again when it comes back. A Discord webhook address is detected automatically; anything else receives JSON.

scheduler.unknown: Garrison has not run a check yet.
scheduler.stalled_help: Nothing has run Garrison's checks for a while, so no server is being watched, restarted or backed up. Flarum's scheduler is what runs them, and it needs this in the server's crontab: * * * * * php /path/to/forum/flarum schedule:run

queue.unknown: Garrison has not checked whether alerts are getting through yet.
queue.stalled_help: Garrison sends alerts as background jobs, and nothing on this forum has run one for a while — so a server going down would be recorded here and nobody would be told. This is usually a queue worker that has stopped; restarting it is the fix.

schedules.title: Scheduled
schedules.none: Nothing scheduled. Add a nightly restart, a backup, or a message to players.
schedules.warn: Warn players this many minutes beforehand
schedules.warn_line_placeholder: say Restarting in 15 minutes — finish up and log out

provision.none: This host has no install templates. They are declared in the agent's config file.
provision.started: Installing {id}. It appears here when it is ready; the download can take a while, and the progress is in that server's console.
provision.failed: The install could not be started.
provision.no_answer: The host has not answered yet. It may still be working.
provision.needs_a_server: This host has no servers yet, so there is nothing to send the request through. Add the first one to the agent's config by hand.

admin.no_identities: Nobody has linked a forum account to an in-game character yet.
admin.identity_unlink_confirm: Unlink {player}? Their time played stays on the server's leaderboard; only the connection to a forum account is removed.
admin.no_hosts: No hosts paired yet. Give one a name and pair it, then put the token in that host's agent config.
admin.unpair_confirm: Unpair {name}? Its {count} server(s) will disappear from the forum until it is paired again.
admin.token_once: This token is shown once and is stored nowhere. Copy it now — if you lose it you will have to unpair and pair again.
admin.token_next: Put it in the host's agent config as the token, then start the agent.
admin.public: Show this server to everyone, including guests
admin.auto_remediate: Restart this server automatically when it stops accepting players
admin.attention: Garrison stopped trying to restart this server. It needs looking at.
admin.clear_attention: I have looked — resume automatic restarts
admin.backup_every_help: Zero means no automatic backups. The agent keeps the most recent copies and never deletes a safety copy taken before a restore.
admin.icon_help: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 512 KB. Uploaded and kept here, so it cannot disappear later.
admin.fetch_logo_help: Downloads the game's own logo and keeps a copy on this forum. Not a hotlink — it cannot break later.
admin.logo_url_help: For games Garrison does not know, paste a link to the logo. It is downloaded and kept here, so it cannot break later.
